primary_hypothesis: On the same persistent-delta plus periodic-attention generator and semantic cases, supervised compact verified reasoning traces followed by a delimited final answer improve free-generated final-answer reasoning versus final-answer-only supervision.
output_contract: both arms are prompted to finish with F=<integer>; main receives compact replayable trace targets before F=; control receives only F= target
trace_verification: every generated training/validation target is independently replayed from semantic case before use; held traces are not training inputs
selection: fixed final step1000 only; no held checkpoint selection
scoring: free generation; deterministic F= parser independent of gold; strict structured-final accuracy plus semantic trace validity diagnostics
compute: same model params/examples/updates but trace arm has more supervised/output tokens and therefore more FLOPs; report both
no_oracle: model call gets prompt bytes only; gold/case/trace are outside inference
scope: objective/reasoning-curriculum probe, not 300-800M result, not Qwen parity
